# Business Brief — Sales Trend & Customer Churn (one page)

**InternCircle Data Science & AI Internship — Ritun Kumar (IC-2026-E21E85D134E22C70)**

**Important:** this brief is based on simulated e-commerce data (5,000 orders, 1,200 customer IDs, of which 1,177 placed at least one order, January 2024–December 2025, in INR), generated by `sales_analysis.py` with seed 42. It is not real customer data. Exact figures are in `outputs/sales_summary.md`, which the script writes when it runs.

## Key numbers (verified by running the script)

- Total net revenue: INR 45,058,908.70; average order value: INR 9,011.78.
- Best month: December 2024 (INR 2,733,896.57); weakest month: February 2025 (INR 1,361,344.15).
- By category: Electronics INR 23,647,432.74; Home & Kitchen INR 9,741,042.89; Clothing INR 5,441,767.64; Sports INR 4,416,852.88; Beauty INR 1,811,812.55.
- By region: North INR 13,974,669.53; South INR 12,620,538.69; West INR 10,710,722.96; East INR 7,752,977.52.
- By segment: Platinum 236 customers / INR 20,710,369; Gold 443 / INR 17,732,743; Silver 379 / INR 6,109,915; Bronze 119 / INR 505,882.
- Churn: Active 578, At risk 239, Churned 360 (30.6% of customers). Repeat customers (2+ orders): 1,095 of 1,177.

## What was done

- Built date features (Year, Month, Quarter, Weekday, Weekend) and money features (Revenue, Discount, Net Revenue) from every order.
- Built pivot tables for monthly revenue, revenue by category, by region, by category x region, and by quarter.
- Segmented customers by lifetime spend (Bronze / Silver / Gold / Platinum) and flagged churn: Active (ordered within 90 days), At risk (91–180 days), Churned (over 180 days with no order).

## What the analysis shows

- Revenue is seasonal: December 2024 was the strongest month and February 2025 the weakest, so the festive quarter (October–December) is the peak. Plan stock and marketing around that peak, not after it.
- Categories do not contribute equally: Electronics brings over half the revenue (INR 23.6 million of INR 45.1 million), while Clothing brings the most orders (1,485) at a much lower average value. Put the high-revenue categories first in promotions and in homepage placement.
- Regions differ: North leads (INR 14.0 million) and East trails (INR 7.8 million). Do not run the same offer everywhere — target the category-region combinations that already work.
- A real share of customers has churned: 360 of 1,177 customers (30.6%) have not ordered in over 180 days. Those customers are the cheapest growth available, because they have already bought once.

## Recommendations

1. **Protect the festive peak.** Stock up and start campaigns before October, using December 2024 (INR 2,733,896.57) as the target to beat.
2. **Win back churned customers.** Offer the 360 Churned customers a reason to return (for example a discount on the category they bought before); contact the 239 At-risk customers before they cross 180 days.
3. **Grow Gold and Platinum customers.** Together they are 679 customers bringing INR 38.4 million — give them early access to new products and a loyalty offer, and measure whether their repeat rate rises.
4. **Fix the weak combinations.** For the lowest cells in the category-x-region pivot, test a local offer or a different product mix instead of more spending on the strongest cells.
5. **Watch the monthly trend, not just the total.** Re-run `sales_analysis.py` each month and compare the new monthly revenue and churn share with the summary; a falling month or a rising churn share is the early warning.

## How to reproduce

```bash
pip install pandas numpy matplotlib seaborn
python sales_analysis.py
```

Charts are saved in `outputs/`, and the exact totals are in `outputs/sales_summary.md`.
